name: Ebed-melech
bio: Ebed-melech, a Cushite eunuch serving in King Zedekiah's palace, heard that officials had thrown Jeremiah into a muddy cistern to die and pleaded with the king to rescue him. Zedekiah authorized it, and Ebed-melech, with thirty men, used old rags as padding under Jeremiah's arms to pull him out with ropes without injury (Jeremiah 38:7-13). Because of this act of compassion, the LORD promised through Jeremiah that Ebed-melech alone would be spared when Jerusalem fell (Jeremiah 39:15-18).
